sentences.en: Your site appeals to people who are interested in cats.
sentences.zh: 你的网站吸引了对猫感兴趣的用户。

sentences.en: We should appeal to reason instead of resorting to violence.
sentences.zh: 我们应该诉诸理性而非暴力。

sentences.en: I appeal to you to contribute to the new clinic.
sentences.zh: 我恳请你为新诊所捐款。
